scope.evidence_rule: Only source-bound archaeological, museum, archival, analytical, textual, publication or expert-response records are allowed to promote historical claims. Project heuristics and semantic/computational artifacts are excluded from promotion.

operator_taxonomy.LOCALIZE_MEMBER: Textually/geographically assign a body member or relic role to a locality.
operator_taxonomy.MANUFACTURE_SUBSTITUTE: Create a ritually effective Osirian body/member/simulacrum from non-biological matter.
operator_taxonomy.REPAIR_RE_MEMBER_IMAGE: Retain part of a damaged Osiris image and materially reconstruct missing portions.
operator_taxonomy.CONTAIN_ENCASE: Use a sheath, box, basin, coffin, niche, mould or related carrier around/for a body-role object.
operator_taxonomy.PROTECT_CARDINAL: Use protective figures/boxes/spatial arrangement to guard the Osirian body or ritual product.
operator_taxonomy.DEPOSIT_BURY: Place the ritual body/product/equipment in a funerary or sacred deposit.
operator_taxonomy.RENEW_REPLACE: Replace an earlier ritual Osiris body/product with a newly manufactured one in a recurring cycle.
operator_taxonomy.SYMBOLIZE_BODY_AXIS: Materially represent a body-axis/member role such as the djed/spine without proving biological continuity.
operator_taxonomy.RECEIVE_REINTERPRET_HUMAN_REMAINS: A real human body member is present in a monument later received as Osirian; identity remains independent.
operator_taxonomy.CONSECRATE_TRANSFORM: Ritually transform a material carrier into an Osirian body/member role without implying biological identity.

matrix.context: Tell Ibn es-Salam / Mendes; Engelbach site-level JE range 35420-42 includes JE35425.
matrix.passport: CG53469 = JE35425 locked in current anti-loop state; historical photograph/Plate LXXXVII recovered; exact internal-content/conservation state open.
matrix.biological_control: Louvre E13463 demonstrates that a metal phallus envelope can contain mummified organic tissue, so catalogue wording alone cannot prove an envelope empty. This is a class control, not evidence for CG53469 contents.
matrix.strongest_admissible_claim: A source-bound gold phallus sheath from Tell Ibn es-Salam exists and has a stable museum identity. Its internal contents and any specifically Osirian biological identity are unknown.
not_admitted: CG53469 is a literal phallus of Osiris
CG53469 is directly paired with the Tell el-Rub'a djed

object: rough gold-foil sheaths for fingers, toes and phallus
matrix.context: Quibell's protected funerary gold assemblage at Tell el-Rub'a; separate from Tell Ibn es-Salam registration branch.
matrix.passport: Grouped stamped-gold series is secure; individual djed JE/CG/TR passport and exact body coordinate remain open.
matrix.biological_control: The objects were associated with a human funerary body context, but symbolic/covering objects do not identify a divine biological member.
matrix.strongest_admissible_claim: Tell el-Rub'a preserves an Osirian/body-axis symbolic djed group and gold body-covering practices in a human funerary assemblage; the djed's individual passport and any direct pairing with a particular phallus sheath remain unresolved.
not_admitted: gold phallus sheath class = authenticated biological relic

body_member: real human forearm; later Osirian tomb reception
object: linen-wrapped human forearm with four bracelets; surviving bracelets JE35054; photo AB-RT.NEG.II.005; linen proxy UC35716A; Tomb O hair/bone controls
matrix.context: Early Dynastic Tomb O of Djer, later treated as the Tomb of Osiris.
matrix.passport: Original forearm lost/discarded after Cairo transfer; bracelets and multiple proxies survive with stable records; direct arm C14 impossible.
matrix.biological_control: This is the strongest internal control: an actual human member in a monument later understood as Osirian still does not become biologically 'Osiris' without an independent identity chain.
matrix.strongest_admissible_claim: A real human body member was found in a monument later identified with Osiris; surviving proxies show how cultic reinterpretation and biological material can coexist without proving divine identity.
not_admitted: Tomb O hair = same individual as forearm

object: Louvre E11072, cylindrical diorite multipart support with four lion fronts, central through-socket and annular rebates
matrix.context: Later scholarship associates it with an Abydos head-of-Osiris reliquary; primary 1905 Louvre register shows it as one joining part of a larger assemblage; pre-museum provenance remains contested.
matrix.passport: Louvre E11072 stable museum passport; original complete assemblage and secure excavated findspot unresolved.
matrix.biological_control: No verified contents and no biological material are bound to the object.
matrix.strongest_admissible_claim: E11072 is a mechanically joining component of a multipart ritual/reliquary assemblage and is interpreted in scholarship as Abydos/Osirian; its contents and original excavated provenance are not established.
not_admitted: E11072 contained the literal head of Osiris

material: one verified gold-leaf finish on QH207/40
matrix.context: Late Period QH207 Burial 1 / Room 1 association is strong; deceased group socially/geographically linked to Elephantine priestly elite; exact microposition of each small object remains open.
matrix.passport: QH207/39, /40, /55 Bonn inventory supported; /32 and /38 whereabouts unknown; /32↔/38 association strong-probable; imaging archive partly recoverable.
matrix.biological_control: Mixed object lifecycle: one previously finished/gilded fragment exists, but at least one workshop-fresh failed cast also occurs. Therefore old sacred-object reuse cannot be generalized to every fragment.
matrix.strongest_admissible_claim: Ancient craftspeople materially re-membered damaged Osiris images by retaining bronze fragments and modelling missing bodies in wax; local ritual use is a published hypothesis, while a causal link to a First Cataract physical relic tradition remains open.
not_admitted: QH207 fragments are biological Osiris parts
all fragments were previously used cult images
Elephantine leg theology proves the cause of the repair process

body_member: left leg of Osiris in textual tradition
object: Dendera-prescribed local Osiris figure/shred for Elephantine-Abaton rites
material: for the ritual substitute: local sand plus barley/sand; physical biological relic not recovered
matrix.context: Abaton/Biggeh sacred landscape; modern site affected by water and under active survey; proposed tomb/grove coordinates are scholarly reconstruction, not excavated coordinates.
matrix.passport: No portable left-leg relic passport; site/topographic mission exists; material ritual recipe is textual.
matrix.biological_control: The Dendera rite itself prescribes manufactured non-biological substitute matter in an Elephantine-Abaton local context.
matrix.strongest_admissible_claim: Biggeh preserves a strong textual left-leg relic geography while the ritual corpus also prescribes manufactured local Osirian substitute matter; no surviving biological left-leg relic is established.
not_admitted: submerged Osirian site = submerged body part
textual left leg = surviving biological leg

object: 1956 cache recorded as 56 Osiris statuettes plus fragments
material: ritual substitute ingredients including barley/sand/earth in Dendera prescription
matrix.context: 1956 accidental water-line/drainage discovery at Ehnasya; exact trench/depth/sealed context remains open; Osiris-Naref is locally attested but object-level join remains unproven.
matrix.passport: Common store Record 26 passes; working IDs such as 1/26 etc are not official inventory numbers; exact register locator and current individual IDs remain open.
matrix.biological_control: The local Dendera/Naref ritual recipe explicitly allows manufactured Osirian substitute matter; a large bronze Osiris cache is therefore not equivalent to a biological relic cache.
matrix.strongest_admissible_claim: Heracleopolis uniquely converges textual multi-member theology, a real local Osiris image cache, a local Osiris-Naref cult, and a manufactured-substitute ritual prescription, but no source-bound join currently connects these into one relic container/deposit.

matrix.context: Ptolemaic/Roman-period Mysteries of Osiris ritual prescriptions in Dendera chapels.
matrix.passport: Textual ritual specification rather than one archaeological object passport; several equipment classes have archaeological comparanda elsewhere.
matrix.biological_control: Decisive: the same ritual corpus can call products relic/shred/member while explicitly prescribing their manufacture from non-biological ingredients.
matrix.strongest_admissible_claim: Dendera establishes a formal ritual technology in which Osirian body/member identity can be produced by combining prescribed non-biological materials and equipment; relic terminology therefore does not imply biological continuity.
not_admitted: fourteen utensils contain fourteen biological body parts

body_member: whole Osirian ritual body / local shred role
material: pink granite basin; ritual product expected from grain/sand-type Osirian manufacture
matrix.context: Coptos; object linked by texts and expert interpretation to actual Osirian germination/manufacture.
matrix.passport: JE37516 stable Egyptian Museum object; current public access limited; residue/wear dossier incomplete.
matrix.biological_control: No published residue/conservation analysis proving surviving biological/human material; function is ritual manufacture, not relic storage.
matrix.strongest_admissible_claim: JE37516 is strongly supported as actual equipment for manufacturing an Osirian figure; direct residue evidence and a join to a particular burial/cache remain open.

body_member: whole manufactured Osirian effigy; reassembly symbolism
material: earth/barley-type Osirian manufacture as published interpretation
matrix.context: Holy of Holies of the great temple of Heracleion and ritual deposits in sacred waterway.
matrix.passport: SCA0459 and multiple tool inventory numbers stable; no complete archaeologically secured set of fourteen member-vessels identified in reviewed public documentation.
matrix.biological_control: Physical equipment and deposits support performance of ritual manufacture but provide no evidence for biological Osiris parts.
matrix.strongest_admissible_claim: Thonis provides an archaeological equipment-level anchor for Osirian manufacture and ritual handling comparable to the Dendera process, without a demonstrated biological relic.

object: associated clay balls and funerary equipment
matrix.context: Ptolemaic Osirian cemetery discovered in 1994 Ring Road works; small individual shafts/chambers with annual/funerary Osiris packages.
matrix.passport: Core 501/1-501/5 numbers known from dissertation tradition; reported storeroom location; original tomb-by-tomb SCA associations and full current inventory remain open.
matrix.biological_control: The Osiris bodies are archaeologically described as manufactured clay/grain figures, directly demonstrating non-biological embodiments in burial contexts.
matrix.strongest_admissible_claim: Giza preserves physical burial packages for manufactured Osiris bodies and thereby anchors the deposition stage of the ritual-substitute lifecycle.
not_admitted: reported ithyphallic remains = original phallus of Osiris

body_member: protected body as a ritual unit
matrix.context: Subterranean Osireion with year-by-year inscribed niches from Ptolemaic periods; annual burial/replacement cycle.
matrix.passport: Annual Osiris burial sequence archaeologically/published; exact box crosswalk 15307a-f secured through expert mapping; individual in-situ x/y/z orientation of the six niche-2 boxes remains unknown.
matrix.biological_control: Published complete/degraded figures are manufactured from mud/bitumen/barley and wrapped in linen; protective equipment guards a ritual body rather than demonstrating biological tissue.
matrix.strongest_admissible_claim: Oxyrhynchus provides the clearest archaeological example of recurrent manufacture, protection, burial and replacement of material Osiris bodies; box-specific cardinal geometry remains unproven.
not_admitted: general cardinal ritual = proven six-box geometry

hypothesis_A_single_uniform_artifact_typ.reason: Across the matrix the relevant carriers are sheaths, djed foils, human remains, bronze/wax repair moulds, basins, coffins, niches, ritual boxes and manufactured earth/grain figures. No single morphology or material class spans the sites.

hypothesis_B_shared_material_operator_gr.exceptional_operator: REPAIR_RE_MEMBER_IMAGE is strongly anchored at QH207 and should not be generalized to all Osirian sites.
hypothesis_B_shared_material_operator_gr.interpretation: The cross-site regularity is better described as a grammar of transformations applied to Osirian identity than as circulation of one physical relic type.

strongest_controls: Dendera explicitly manufactures relic/body-role matter from non-biological ingredients.
Giza and Oxyrhynchus preserve manufactured Osiris bodies archaeologically.
Abydos Tomb O shows that even real human tissue in a later Osirian monument does not identify the tissue as Osiris.
CG53469 remains content-unknown despite a stable phallus-sheath passport.

promising_cases: Elephantine/First Cataract leg theology ↔ QH207 concentration on broken feet/lower parts, but causality remains a published hypothesis rather than proof.
Biggeh left-leg theology ↔ local manufactured substitute prescriptions, but no physical relic recovered.
Heracleopolis multi-member theology ↔ local Osiris cache + Naref manufacture tradition, but object-context join remains open.
Mendes/Tell el-Rub'a phallus/djed traditions ↔ phallus sheaths and djed imagery, but current provenance branches must remain separated.
hypothesis_D_local_member_theology_predi.required_test: Pre-register member-specific expectations by locality, then compare against matched Osirian and non-Osirian assemblages using object counts, context quality and preservation bias controls.

hypothesis_E_relic_word_implies_biologic.decisive_reason: Dendera prescriptions explicitly produce local Osirian relic/shred/body-role matter from barley, sand, earth and other ingredients.

synthesis_candidate.label: OSIRIS_MATERIAL_BODY_OPERATOR_GRAMMAR
synthesis_candidate.statement: Across heterogeneous local traditions, Osirian bodily identity is repeatedly instantiated through operations on material carriers—localizing, manufacturing, repairing, enclosing, protecting, depositing and renewing—without requiring continuous biological substance.
synthesis_candidate.novelty_caution: Prior scholarship already treats Osirian relic geography, manufactured simulacra, replacement body parts and QH207 re-membering separately. The potential contribution is the explicit source-bound cross-site operator matrix plus negative controls and passport/provenance gates, not the discovery of substitution or reassembly itself.

killer_tests.question: Do local body-member traditions predict an excess of member-specific material operations at the same sites beyond general Osiris-cult frequency and preservation bias?
killer_tests.design: Freeze local member prediction first; build matched controls from other Osirian sites/assemblages; count member-specific objects/repair/container roles; separate textual prediction from archaeological outcome.
killer_tests.promotion_rule: Only a pre-registered, matched comparative excess can advance a causal local-theology/material-practice claim.

killer_tests.question: Do different material carriers (wax/bronze, grain/earth, gold sheath, djed, coffin/box) share explicit ancient language of embodiment/relic/member identity, or are modern interpretations creating the equivalence?
killer_tests.design: Collect primary Egyptian terms, date, locality and syntactic role for each carrier; reject equivalence inferred only from modern labels.

killer_tests.question: Is any candidate able to survive the sequence ORGANIC -> HUMAN -> SECURE_CONTEXT -> INDIVIDUALIZATION -> IDENTITY without relying on Osirian context alone?
killer_tests.current_result: No candidate in this matrix passes the full sequence.
